title: Part-Time Accounts Assistant Dartford Temp to Perm
description:
Are you an experienced Accounts Assistant looking for a part-time opportunity? We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented individual to join a busy finance team in Dartford on a temporary to permanent basis.

This is a fully office-based role supporting the day-to-day running of the finance function.

Role: Accounts Assistant - XERO Experience Required
Location: Dartford (on-site parking)
Hours: Part-Time Monday to Friday 9:00am - 2:00pm / 9:30am - 2:30pm 10:00am / 3:00pm
Start: Monday 19th October
Term: Temp to perm
Pay: £15.00 - £16.00 per hour

Key Responsibilities:
- Maintain and process Purchase Ledger and Sales Ledger transactions
- Raise customer invoices and ensure they are issued accurately and on time
- Manage credit control, including chasing overdue payments and resolving payment queries
- Perform regular bank reconciliations
- Process receipts, expenses, and supplier invoices
- Use Xero and Eworks to maintain accurate financial records
- Assist with month-end procedures and reporting
- Reconcile accounts and investigate discrepancies
- Support the wider finance team with ad hoc administrative duties
- Maintain accurate filing and record-keeping systems

About You:
- Previous experience using Xero Accounting Software
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Confident communication skills and a professional approach
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Ability to manage confidential information appropriately

This is an excellent opportunity to join a friendly and supportive team, gain valuable experience, and secure immediate work.

Why Apply?
- Immediate start available
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- Opportunity to gain experience within a busy operational setting
- Weekly pay through Office Angels
- Dedicated consultant support throughout your assignment

Next Steps

If you have the relevant experience and are available for to start ASAP, please apply today with your most up-to-date CV.

Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We use generative AI tools to support our candidate screening process. This helps us ensure a fair, consistent, and efficient experience for all applicants. Rest assured, all final decisions are made by our hiring team, and your application will be reviewed with care and attention.
